epic.title: Epic 569: attestation that can fail — evidence, review, instruments
epic.intent_and_why: Make a green qualitative gate mean something by telling the agent what would count at plan time, not by telling it at attest time that it got it wrong. 65 of 105 conditions in the shipped spine templates are check:null, so the agent must invent the standard itself at the most expensive moment in the run.

definition_of_done: A qualitative condition declares, at plan time, what evidence would satisfy it.
A wedged verdict is impossible to express silently.
The journal distinguishes a repaired fail from a gate that never failed.
Every check this epic ships is reachable from a template command check, or allowlisted with a stated reason.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: This epic must not add machinery that is itself unwired.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Measured census plus red-proof pinned to the shipped revision; a report-only check must name its promotion trigger.
good_enough.appetite: Four waves; cleared autonomous through wave 2, stop-and-present before wave 3.

hard_constraints: Report-only is a staging state for an unmeasured signal, never a substitute for adjudication.
Sonnet for every commander and crew slot; escalate to opus only on a double block.
Fix or write an episode; filing an issue is the disfavoured exit.
fixed_decisions: Delivery-first inversion: the built-not-wired guarantee runs first, not last.
WP5 reviewer machinery stays inside 569 as wave 4.
#558 is a design question settled with the human before wave 3, not dispatched to a commander.

current_wave.objective: Guarantee that what this epic delivers is actually wired, and close the one gate in the corpus that cannot pass.
exit_criteria: A committed census classifying all 26 check-shaped scripts, with the generate_spine.py disposition settled on evidence.
Either a registration lint plus vocabulary rule, or deletions and a recorded honest null.
A list-valued match works and is red-proved against the shipped revision.
Both PRs merged green to main.

issues.title: Built-not-wired: measure the unwired population, then lint or delete (#345 #444 #368)
issues.desired_outcome: Every check-shaped script in scripts/ is either reachable from a template `command` check, or deleted, or on an allowlist with a stated reason — and a lint keeps it that way. The disposition of generate_spine.py is settled with evidence.
issues.useful_now: Nothing later in this epic is trustworthy until 'built' stops meaning 'not wired'. Work package 1 rests on generate_spine.py, which has zero callers in skills/.
issues.appetite: One commander, one wave. Measurement first; the lint is only built if measurement says the population is unwired rather than dead.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A committed census of all 26 check-shaped scripts classified live/unwired/dead with evidence per row. If mostly dead: deletions and NO lint (honest null, a complete deliverable). If mostly unwired: a registration lint plus the #345 vocabulary rule.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the lint's implementation and where it runs. Do not choose whether the pattern deserves a mechanism at all without reporting the census that decided it.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not fix this by adding another unwired checker (#345's own words).
Any new refusing check ships report-only WITH a named promotion trigger in the same PR.
Compact-format JSON templates are edited as raw text, never round-tripped through json.load/json.dump.
Re-measure #368's field group; the census in the issue is stale by map_check_note (commit 244665ee).
local_unknowns: How many of the 19 unreferenced scripts are dead vs merely unwired
Whether any live path needs generate_spine.py

issues.title: Verdict mechanism: list-valued match, and refuse a mistyped match shape (#371)
issues.desired_outcome: A `match` may name a set of acceptable values, and a mistyped match shape is refused at validate rather than becoming a silently unsatisfiable gate.
issues.useful_now: This is a check that cannot PASS. The wedge pushes a Commander toward attaching a second evidence item with a verdict the reviewer never gave — the fabrication this epic exists to prevent.
issues.appetite: Small. Two identical comparison sites plus tests.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A red-proof that a list-valued match is unsatisfiable before the change and satisfiable after, pinned to the shipped revision; plus a test that a mistyped match shape is reported.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the accepted match shape (list, or a richer operator form) and argue it. Preserve backward compatibility with every existing scalar match in the corpus.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Widening the comparison ships LIVE. The new validate_spine refusal ships report-only with a named promotion trigger.
APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOWUPS no longer exists in the corpus — do not reintroduce it. The measured vocabulary is APPROVE 34 / BLOCK 24 / REJECT 4 / COMMENT 3.
#558 (review-level doctrine) is NOT in scope and is not to be answered here.
local_unknowns: Whether REJECT and COMMENT are live vocabulary or strays
